title: Creamy, Cheesy Garlic Mushroom Risotto
description: A baked mushroom and garlic risotto finished with peas, spring onions, lemon juice and grated Parmesan.

ingredients.text: 400g white mushrooms, sliced, leave any smaller mushrooms whole
4 garlic cloves, peeled and crushed or finely chopped
1 tbsp Henderson’s relish or Worcestershire sauce
1 litre vegetable stock (2 vegetable stock cubes dissolved in
1 bunch of spring onions, trimmed and thinly sliced
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Spray an ovenproof pan (that has a lid) with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened slightly, then add the mushrooms and fry for about 5 minutes until the mushrooms start to release water.
Add the garlic, dried Italian herbs, white wine vinegar and Henderson’s relish, stir well and cook for a further 2 minutes, then add the rice and stir.
Pour in the stock and bring the mixture to the boil.
Remove the pan from the heat and place the lid tightly on the pan.
Place in the preheated oven and cook for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and stir in the lemon juice, spring onions and peas.
Cover with the lid and return to the oven for a final 5 minutes.
Remove the lid and sprinkle with the grated cheese, and season with salt and pepper.
